environment: Tauri v2 / WebView2 / disposable profile / fake local Core
visualLimitations: The timing baseline was established after the Marco 70 implementation and is intended to block future regressions; earlier releases did not expose equivalent native timing telemetry.
Chromium Performance metrics are reported when WebView2Driver exposes the DevTools bridge; the stable-frame phase remains the paint boundary when it does not.

Listener, observer, and RAF counters cover resources created after the automation-only hook is installed, which is sufficient to detect growth across repeated section changes but is not a process-wide inventory.

budgets.baselineMethod: Marco 70 wall-clock medians remain diagnostic; Marco 72G blocks app-owned shell activation and directional Library phases. Cold references use four balanced post-GC calibration runs; compositor-only p95 remains observational because WebView2 scheduling is environment-sensitive.
